quests.instruction: Which of these belongs to the grains group?
quests.hint: It is made from corn or wheat.
quests.explanation: Tortillas are made from ground corn or wheat, so they are grain foods. Cheese is dairy and an orange is a fruit.
quests.funFact: Whole grains keep all three parts of the grain seed: the bran, the germ and the center.

quests.instruction: Which of these is counted in the fruit group by food guides, even though it is often eaten in savory dishes?
quests.hint: It grows around one big seed.
quests.explanation: Food guides place avocados in the fruit group. Cucumbers are counted as vegetables and corn is a grain or starchy vegetable.
quests.funFact: Avocados have more fat than most fruits, but it is a kind of fat the body can use well.

quests.instruction: Which of these foods belongs to the protein group?
quests.hint: It is an animal food from the water.
quests.explanation: Fish is a protein food. Bread is a grain food and grapes are a fruit.
quests.funFact: Meat, poultry, fish, eggs, beans, nuts and seeds are all in the protein group.

quests.instruction: Milk, yogurt and cheese are rich in which mineral that helps build strong bones and teeth?
quests.hint: Think about your skeleton.
quests.explanation: Calcium is the mineral that strengthens bones and teeth. Sugar and salt do not do that job.
quests.funFact: Bones keep growing stronger all through childhood and the teenage years.

quests.instruction: Oranges, strawberries and red peppers are all rich in which vitamin?
quests.hint: It is named after a letter near the start of the alphabet.
quests.explanation: These foods are packed with vitamin C. Calcium is found in dairy foods and protein is found in meat and beans.
quests.funFact: Vitamins are tiny substances in food that help the body work properly.

quests.instruction: Beans, fish and eggs are good sources of which nutrient that helps the body grow and repair itself?
quests.hint: Muscles are partly made of it.
quests.explanation: Protein helps build and repair the body. Vitamin C and fiber do other jobs.
quests.funFact: Hair and nails are made of protein too.

quests.instruction: What food is a starchy staple that gives the body quick energy for running and playing?
quests.hint: It is a grain that is often cooked in water.
quests.explanation: Starchy foods like rice give the body plenty of energy. Lettuce and cucumber are mostly water.
quests.funFact: The body breaks the starch in rice, bread and potatoes down into sugars it can use for energy.

quests.instruction: Which part of whole grains, beans and many fruits and vegetables helps keep digestion moving along?
quests.hint: It comes only from plants.
quests.explanation: Fiber is the part of plant foods that the body does not digest, and it helps food move through. Fat and salt do different jobs.
quests.funFact: Fiber comes only from plant foods. Meat and dairy foods have none.

quests.instruction: Which bread keeps more of the grain's natural fiber?
quests.hint: Look for the darker, seedier loaf.
quests.explanation: Whole-grain bread is made from the whole grain, so it keeps more fiber than white bread or a croissant.
quests.funFact: A loaf marked whole grain should list a whole grain, such as whole wheat, first on its label.

quests.instruction: Which of these foods is mostly water, so it helps you stay hydrated too?
quests.hint: Juicy foods hold a lot of water.
quests.explanation: Strawberries are made mostly of water. Crackers and raisins have had the water dried out.
quests.funFact: Many fruits and vegetables are about nine-tenths water.

quests.instruction: Which feeling is your body's signal that it needs a drink?
quests.hint: Your mouth might feel dry.
quests.explanation: Feeling thirsty is the body's way of asking for water. Sleepiness and shivering have other causes.
quests.funFact: Your body gets water from drinks and also from the juicy foods you eat.

quests.instruction: Which is a good way to remember to drink water during a busy school day?
quests.correctAnswer: Keep a refillable water bottle nearby 💧
options: Keep a refillable water bottle nearby 💧
Wait until your mouth feels very dry 🏜️
Save all of your drinks for dinner 🍽️
quests.hint: Make it easy to take a sip.
quests.explanation: Having a bottle close by makes it easy to drink regularly. Waiting until you are very thirsty or saving drinks for dinner leaves your body short.
quests.funFact: Sipping water through the day works better than drinking a lot all at once.

quests.instruction: Why is it a good idea to eat fruits and vegetables of many different colors?
quests.correctAnswer: Each color often has different nutrients 🌈
options: Colors make vegetables taste a lot sweeter 🍬
Each color often has different nutrients 🌈
Only red and orange foods are good for you 🍅
quests.hint: Ask yourself what each color tells you.
quests.explanation: Different colors usually come from different natural substances, so a rainbow of foods gives the body a variety of nutrients.
quests.funFact: Orange foods like carrots contain carotene, which the body can turn into vitamin A.

quests.instruction: Many food guides suggest filling about half of your plate with which foods?
quests.hint: Consider the most colorful part of the plate.
quests.explanation: Fruits and vegetables take up about half of a balanced plate, and the other half is shared by grains and protein foods.
quests.funFact: Countries use pictures of plates, pyramids or bowls to show how to mix foods.

quests.instruction: A lunch has a cheese sandwich and an apple. Which addition would bring in the vegetable group?
quests.hint: It is crunchy and orange.
quests.explanation: Carrot sticks are a vegetable. Milk is dairy and crackers are a grain food.
quests.funFact: Raw vegetable sticks are an easy way to add crunch and color to a lunch.

quests.instruction: What food gives you both protein and fiber?
quests.hint: It grows in a pod.
quests.explanation: Beans are rich in protein and fiber. Butter has fat and cheese has protein but no fiber.
quests.funFact: Beans, peas and lentils are counted with both vegetables and protein foods in many food guides.

quests.instruction: Which of these foods contains fats that the body needs in small amounts?
quests.hint: It can be pressed to make oil.
quests.explanation: Olives are rich in healthy fats. Cucumber and lettuce are mostly water.
quests.funFact: Fats help the body absorb certain vitamins, such as A, D, E and K.

quests.instruction: Iron is a mineral that helps carry oxygen around the body. Which of these is a good source of it?
quests.hint: It is dark green and grows in leaves.
quests.explanation: Leafy greens such as spinach contain iron. Soda and candy do not.
quests.funFact: Vitamin C helps the body use the iron in plant foods.

quests.instruction: Which breakfast has foods from three different groups?
options: A big bowl of plain white rice 🍚
A tall stack of plain pancakes 🥞
quests.hint: Count how many kinds of food are in each bowl.
quests.explanation: Oatmeal is a grain, milk is dairy and berries are fruit. The other breakfasts are made of just one kind of food.
quests.funFact: Mixing groups at breakfast gives you a variety of nutrients to start the day.

quests.instruction: A dinner plate has pasta, chicken and broccoli. Which food would add a fruit?
quests.hint: It is juicy and sweet.
quests.explanation: Pasta is a grain, chicken is protein and broccoli is a vegetable, so orange slices bring in the fruit.
quests.funFact: Fruit makes a simple, sweet ending to a meal in many countries.

quests.instruction: Which plan shows the most variety in protein foods across the week?
quests.correctAnswer: Beans on Monday, fish on Tuesday, eggs on Wednesday 🫘
options: Eggs on Monday, eggs on Tuesday, eggs on Wednesday 🥚
Beans on Monday, fish on Tuesday, eggs on Wednesday 🫘
Chicken at breakfast, lunch and dinner 🍗
quests.hint: Look for protein foods that change each day.
quests.explanation: Rotating beans, fish and eggs brings in different protein foods. Repeating the same one gives less variety.
quests.funFact: Different protein foods bring different nutrients, so changing them adds variety.

quests.instruction: Which of these snacks is a whole grain?
quests.hint: Think about what each kernel really is.
quests.explanation: Plain popcorn is made from whole corn kernels, so it is a whole grain. Gummy bears and lollipops are made mostly of sugar.
quests.funFact: Plain popcorn keeps all the parts of the kernel, which is what makes it a whole grain.

quests.instruction: Which of these is best described as a treat to enjoy sometimes, along with other foods?
quests.hint: It is mostly sugar.
quests.explanation: Candy is a fun treat for now and then. Fruits and vegetables are foods to enjoy often.
quests.funFact: Many cultures have special sweets for celebrations, such as mochi in Japan or baklava in the Middle East.

quests.instruction: Which statement is true?
quests.correctAnswer: No single food gives the body everything 🍽️
options: One food group is enough for a whole day ☝️
Water has all the nutrients we need 💧
No single food gives the body everything 🍽️
quests.hint: Ask yourself why variety matters.
quests.explanation: Every food has a different mix of nutrients, so the body needs a variety of foods.
quests.funFact: Foods are often described by the nutrients they are richest in, but every food has a mixture.

quests.instruction: A peanut butter sandwich includes foods from which two groups?
quests.hint: Consider the bread and the spread.
quests.explanation: Bread is a grain food and peanut butter is counted in the protein group.
quests.funFact: Peanuts are legumes, but many food guides count peanut butter in the protein group.

quests.instruction: A burrito is filled with beans, rice and cheese. Which food groups does it include?
quests.hint: The tortilla counts too.
quests.explanation: The tortilla and rice are grains, beans are protein and cheese is dairy.
quests.funFact: Burritos make portable meals that can include foods from many groups.

quests.instruction: Which of these starchy foods is counted as a vegetable, not a grain?
quests.hint: It grows underground.
quests.explanation: Potatoes are vegetables even though they are starchy. Rice and pasta are grains.
quests.funFact: Potatoes contain vitamin C and potassium.

quests.instruction: A child plays sports all afternoon. Which lunch has lasting energy, protein and a fruit?
options: Soda and a small bag of chips 🥤
quests.hint: Look for a grain, a protein food and a fruit.
quests.explanation: Rice gives lasting energy, chicken provides protein and the apple adds fruit. The other lunches are missing groups.
quests.funFact: Athletes around the world eat meals that mix grains, protein foods and fruits or vegetables.

quests.instruction: Which of these foods gives plant-based protein?
quests.hint: It is made from soybeans.
quests.explanation: Tofu comes from soybeans, so its protein comes from a plant. Cheese and chicken come from animals.
quests.funFact: Many people use tofu, beans and lentils as their main protein foods.

quests.instruction: A lunch has bread, an apple and carrot sticks. Which food would add a protein food?
quests.hint: It comes from a hen.
quests.explanation: A boiled egg is a protein food. Grapes are a fruit and a rice cake is a grain.
quests.funFact: Eggs make a handy packed-lunch protein food when they are kept cool.
